notes:
Venture 0.28 — Terrain following, and a clearer LAUNCH

• Terrain following is back. A plan can follow the ground again, holding its planned height above the terrain the whole way. The terrain goes to the aircraft with the mission, and LAUNCH waits until the aircraft has loaded it. It needs aircraft software that supports terrain following; if the aircraft's does not, the upload says so and nothing is sent.

• LAUNCH reads GPS ALT and waits when the aircraft's GPS height disagrees with the ground under it. If the aircraft's SD card cannot load terrain, LAUNCH reads SD CARD and offers to fly the same plan at a fixed height when the ground allows it.

• When LAUNCH is greyed out, tap it to see why and what to do, with the aircraft's own reasons listed. LAUNCH now also waits for the aircraft's position (NO POS), and reads NOT SENT when the plan on the map has not been uploaded.

• The controller says "Ready to launch" when LAUNCH comes on after a wait.

• If the aircraft refuses to launch, the reason appears over the map and the aircraft goes back to the mode it was in.

• If an upload is refused or fails, the screen says why and shows the mission the aircraft still has. Uploading over the rest of an unfinished survey asks first.

• Configuration is now split into Drone, System and Controller. The aircraft's SD card can be formatted under Drone.

• The operator location keeps going out through short signal losses.

Installing over the top keeps your missions and settings.
